rwa.distributed-value.definition: Circulating (distributed) value of tokenized real-world assets on Solana, excluding stablecoins, fiat, and native crypto. RWA.xyz circulating asset value.

rwa.asset-count.definition: Distinct tokenized real-world assets with a Solana deployment in RWA.xyz.

rwa.holders.definition: Holding addresses summed across Solana RWA tokens in RWA.xyz. An address holding several assets counts once per asset.

rwa.protocol-market-size.kamino.definition: Kamino-reported total RWA market size across its lending markets.
rwa.protocol-market-size.kamino.note: No live RWA-only Kamino endpoint found; DefiLlama protocol-tvl covers all of Kamino.

rwa.asset-value.buidl.definition: Circulating BlackRock BUIDL tokens on Solana, valued at the fund's $1.00 NAV.
rwa.asset-value.buidl.note: RWA.xyz lists 865,066,096.35 BUIDL on Solana; a per-asset rwa-xyz loader could make this live.
